patches.zh: 工具确认和代理完成时响铃并发送桌面通知

patches.zh: 控制终端命令运行前是否需要你的批准。

patches.zh: 标准额度用完后，使用 AI 点数继续调用模型。

patches.en: Reflect on recent successes or corrections to capture reusable skills or rules.
patches.zh: 复盘近期成功经验或纠正事项，沉淀可复用技能或规则。

patches.en: Controls how much detail is shown for the agent's tool calls, commands, and thoughts.
patches.zh: 控制对话中展示代理的工具调用、命令与思考的详细程度。

patches.en: When toggled on, %s collects usage data to help Google enhance performance and features
patches.zh: 启用后，%s 会收集使用数据，帮助 Google 改进性能和功能

patches.en: Create a branch of the current conversation at this point, optionally specifying a project ID to fork into
patches.zh: 在此处创建当前对话分支，可指定要分叉到的项目 ID

patches.en: Copy the last planner response to the clipboard, the n-th with '/copy n', or the /btw answer with '/copy btw'
patches.zh: 将最近规划回复复制到剪贴板；用 '/copy n' 复制第 n 条，用 '/copy btw' 复制 /btw 回复

patches.en: Optional JSON schema string or path to a schema file to enforce structured output (for stream-json, only applicable to the final result)
patches.zh: 可选的 JSON schema 字符串或模式文件路径，用于强制结构化输出（对 stream-json 仅适用于最终结果）

patches.en: 'default': standard behavior. 'accept-edits': auto-approve file edits, prompt for commands. 'plan': research and plan without making changes
patches.zh: 'default': 标准行为；'accept-edits': 自动批准文件编辑，命令仍需确认；'plan': 只调研规划，不作改动

patches.en: Input format for print mode (text, stream-json). stream-json reads one NDJSON message per line from stdin and runs a turn for each; it requires --output-format stream-json
patches.zh: 打印模式的输入格式 (text, stream-json)。stream-json 从 stdin 按行读取 NDJSON 消息并执行交互；需配合 --output-format stream-json

patches.en: When enabled, releasing a mouse text selection copies it to the system clipboard. Only active in alt-screen mode.
patches.zh: 启用后，松开鼠标文本选择即复制到系统剪贴板。仅在全屏模式下生效。

patches.en: Specifies Agent's behavior when asking for review on artifacts. 'always proceeds': Agent never asks (maximizes autonomy, risk of unsafe content). 'agent decides': Agent decides based on complexity. 'asks for review': Agent always asks for review.
patches.zh: 指定代理请求产物审查的方式。'always proceeds': 从不询问（自主性最高，存在不安全内容风险）；'agent decides': 代理按复杂度决定；'asks for review': 始终请求审查。

patches.en: no flickering (altscreen) is ideal for long conversations but requires holding Shift/Option for native text selection. Native Terminal experience (inline) preserves native terminal behavior but may truncate long conversations and flicker when toggling views.
patches.zh: “无闪烁（全屏）”适合长对话，但原生文本选择需按住 Shift/Option。“原生终端（内联）”保留终端原生行为，但长对话可能被截断，切换视图时可能闪烁。

patches.en: Provides a comprehensive guide, quick reference, and sitemap for Google Antigravity (AGY), including the Antigravity CLI (agy), Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, Python SDK, slash commands, keybindings, and customizations (skills, rules, MCP, sidecars). Activate this skill when the user asks questions about how to use, configure, or customize Antigravity, AGY, the agy CLI, the Antigravity IDE, or Antigravity 2.0.
patches.zh: 提供 Google Antigravity（AGY）的完整指南、快速参考和导航，涵盖 Antigravity CLI（agy）、Antigravity 2.0、Antigravity IDE、Python SDK、斜杠命令、快捷键及自定义功能（技能、规则、MCP、sidecar）。当用户询问如何使用、配置或自定义 Antigravity、AGY、agy CLI、Antigravity IDE 或 Antigravity 2.0 时启用此技能。

patches.en: Comprehensive guide and reference for the Antigravity Customization System.
patches.zh: Antigravity 自定义系统完整指南与参考。

patches.en: Use to explain how customizations work, their loading priority, discovery mechanisms,
patches.zh: 介绍自定义机制、加载优先级和发现方式，

patches.en: and to guide the creation of skills, rules, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers.
patches.zh: 并指导创建技能、规则、插件、钩子及 MCP 服务器。

patches.en: How to render rich interactive HTML widgets inline in the chat or as standalone artifacts. Use this skill when you want to show the user diagrams, data visualizations, interactive controls, educational walkthroughs, or any rich visual content beyond plain text and markdown.
patches.zh: 在聊天中内联渲染丰富的交互式 HTML 组件，或作为独立产物展示。当你需要向用户呈现图表、数据可视化、交互控件、教学演示，或任何超越纯文本和 Markdown 的丰富视觉内容时使用此技能。

patches.en: Automatically migrate legacy workflows to modern skills across global and workspace configurations. Scans for existing workflows, creates target SKILL.md files, and safely archives old workflow files.
patches.zh: 自动将旧工作流迁移为现代技能（支持全局与工作区配置）。扫描现有工作流，创建目标 SKILL.md 文件，并安全归档旧工作流。
